name: Gifu

flag.description: A green ring on a white field, holding a squared-off green kanji 岐 (gi).
flag.symbolism: The character 岐 begins the prefecture's name, and the green stands for the beauty of its nature.

hook: Gifu's flag is a green 岐 (gi) in a green ring on white, like a rubber stamp of its own name.
trivia: The Battle of Sekigahara, which sealed Tokugawa rule in 1600, was fought in Gifu.
The thatched farmhouses of Shirakawa-gō are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
